# jwt_signed_token (Resource)

Generates a JWT signed with an asymmetric private key (RSA or ECDSA). The token is computed locally during apply and stored in state as a sensitive computed attribute.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generate an RSA-signed JWT.
resource "jwt_signed_token" "example" {
  algorithm = "RS256"
  key       = file("${path.module}/private-key.pem")

  claims_json = jsonencode({
    iss = "my-issuer"
    sub = "user-42"
    aud = "my-audience"
    exp = timeadd(timestamp(), "1h")
  })
}

output "token" {
  value     = jwt_signed_token.example.token
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `algorithm` (String) Signing algorithm. One of `RS256`, `RS384`, `RS512`, `ES256`, `ES384`, `ES512`.
- `claims_json` (String) The token's claims, as a JSON object.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) PEM-encoded RSA or ECDSA private key matching `algorithm`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) SHA-256 hex digest of the signed token. Stable for a given (algorithm, key, claims_json) tuple.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The signed JWT, as a compact-serialized string.
